beats.say: Leicester City defied impossible odds to become Premier League champions in 2016.
Before the season kicked off, the club was considered a massive underdog to win the division.
They opened their campaign on 8 August 2015 with a victory over Sunderland.
Striker Jamie Vardy made history by scoring in 11 consecutive games, a new Premier League record.
Winger Riyad Mahrez became the first African player to be named PFA Players' Player of the Year.
On 2 May 2016, they were confirmed as champions, marking the first time in history they finished top of England's highest league, proving that Leicester City defied impossible odds.

es.title: La histórica victoria del Leicester City en la Premier League 🏆
es.summary: El Leicester City desafió todas las expectativas al ganar el título de la Premier League 2015 a 16. Fue la primera vez que el club terminó en la cima de la liga más alta de Inglaterra.

hi.title: Leicester City की ऐतिहासिक Premier League जीत 🏆
